## Why This Is Asked
Tests knowledge of dynamic trees and path/subtree aggregates under frequent structural changes, a practical requirement in scalable graph-backed workloads.

## Key Concepts
- Link-Cut Tree basics: makerRoot, access, splay for path queries.
- Path vs subtree aggregates; how to maintain sums under reversals.
- Trade-offs with Euler Tour Trees; when to prefer each.
- Handling duplicates via unique node IDs and careful memory management.
- Edge cases: re-rooting, linking a node that already has a parent, cutting roots.

```java
// skeleton: Link-Cut Tree node and core ops
class Node { long val, sum; boolean rev; Node left, right, parent; int id; }
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you extend to support min/max path queries?
- How would you verify amortized guarantees in a real system?
